summary:
Title: Q3 Strategic Summit on Machine Learning

Date: None

Participants: 
- Sarah
- David
- Alex
- Elena
- Priya
- Marcus

Key Points:
- The scope of machine learning has moved from "predictive analytics" to "cognitive infrastructure."
- The current architectural scope is a hybrid approach, combining fine-tuning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
- The scope of ML research is hyper-focused on breaking the quadratic bottleneck of Transformer attention.
- The infrastructure scope is all about orchestration, using a cascading approach to route queries to the most cost-effective model.
- The scope of user interaction is transitioning to conversational and generative interfaces.

Title: Strategic Discussion on Machine Learning Scope and Roadmap

Date: None

Participants: Priya, Marcus, Sarah, Alex, David, Elena

Key Points: 
- The scope of Digital Twins in manufacturing and supply chain using ML for predictive simulations.
- The importance of flawless data pipelines for powering Digital Twins.
- The need for automated retraining pipelines, model drift management, and compliance vulnerability mitigation.
- The requirement for federated learning, privacy-preserving machine learning, and AI governance.
- The potential disruption of Quantum Machine Learning (QML) and the commoditization of intelligence.

Action Items: 
- Priya: Abstract the infrastructure layer and build a unified inference gateway.
- Marcus: Finalize the AI Governance Framework by the end of next month and initiate a pilot program for federated learning.
- David and Alex: Continue pushing the boundaries on agentic workflows and monitoring the open-source space.
- Elena: Prioritize workflow integration mapping.
- Sarah: Draft the strategic summary and circulate the finalized Q3-Q4 roadmap objectives by Friday.

Decisions: 
- The company will focus on model-agnostic, heavily integrated approach with a unified inference gateway.
- The AI Governance Framework will be finalized by the end of next month.
- A pilot program for federated learning will be initiated with two trusted banking clients.

Title: Q3 Strategic Summit for Machine Learning

Date: None

Participants: Sarah, David, Alex, Elena, Priya, Marcus

Key Points:
- The scope of machine learning has moved from "predictive analytics" to "cognitive infrastructure."
- The current scope of ML encompasses multimodal processing: native audio-in to audio-out, video generation, and complex spatial reasoning.
- The research community is looking past basic generative AI, focusing on autonomous agents and system-2 thinking.
- The scope of ML is shifting from "AI as an assistant" to "AI as a digital collaborator."
- The scope of ML development must include building in data provenance tracking from day one.
- The architecture of enterprise ML systems is evolving, with a hybrid approach combining fine-tuning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
- The scope of ML research is hyper-focused on breaking the quadratic bottleneck of Transformer attention.

- The necessity of flawless data pipelines for powering Digital Twins.
- The importance of MLOps, streaming data engineering, and model drift management.
- The need for federated learning, privacy-preserving machine learning, and AI governance.
- The potential disruption of Quantum Machine Learning (QML) and the commoditization of intelligence.

- Marcus: Finalize the AI Governance Framework by the end of next month and initiate a pilot program for federated learning.
